quarterly_data.quarter: Accretech (Tokyo Seimitsu) semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-05-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half ended September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 77,070 million (+7.9%), operating income JPY 14,717 million (+9.8%), ordinary income JPY 14,978 million (+13.8%); after an extraordinary loss of JPY 2,103 million for countermeasures against a defect in some semiconductor manufacturing equipment products, profit attributable to owners of the parent was JPY 9,612 million (-29.1%). Segments: Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment net sales JPY 59,413 million (+9.4%), operating income JPY 12,329 million (+10.7%); Metrology Equipment net sales JPY 17,657 million (+3.2%), operating income JPY 2,388 million (+5.4%). R&D expenses JPY 5,531 million.

quarterly_data.quarter: Accretech (Tokyo Seimitsu) semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-05-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment, first half (semi-annual report): orders rose year on year, led by HPC demand including generative AI - in particular inquiries for test equipment for HBM (High Bandwidth Memory), which gained momentum in the latter part of the period - and by strong demand from China as it localizes production of various high-performance semiconductor devices. Shipments broadly met customer-requested delivery dates, although a typhoon delayed some product transport to customers and some installations slipped to later periods for other reasons. In Metrology Equipment, new capex by auto and auto-parts makers, relatively more exposed to tariff policy, kept being pushed back, while replacement demand stayed stable and demand from aerospace/defense and subsidy-backed projects grew; orders were flat year on year and the charge/discharge test system business recorded a certain level of sales.
